content.query:
IF EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 CNT
		FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN
		WHERE TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL'
			AND PROCESS_DATE = CAST('2025-11-28' AS DATE)
		)
BEGIN
	DELETE
	FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL
	WHERE AS_OF_DATE = CAST('2025-11-28' AS DATE);
END;

WITH CUST_TOT_REL_DEP
AS (
	SELECT EDA.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE
		,EDA.BANK_ID BANK_ID
		,ECD.ORGKEY CIF
		,SUM(COALESCE(YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP, 0)) TRB_DEPOSITS
		,NULL TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
		,NULL TRB_BANCA
		,NULL TRB_SECURITIES
		,NULL TRE_LOANS
		,NULL TRE_CARDS
	FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE
			AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
	WHERE EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN (
			'M'
			,'J'
			)
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND LEFT(EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE, 2) <> '09'
		AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C'
		AND EDF.DEL_FLG = 'N'
		AND EDA.DEL_FLG = 'N'
		AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('2025-11-28' AS DATE)
		AND TRIM(EDA.CUST_ID) IS NOT NULL
		AND TRIM(EDA.CUST_ID) <> ''
	GROUP BY EDA.AS_OF_DATE
		,EDA.BANK_ID
		,ECD.ORGKEY
	)
	,CUST_TOT_REL_TRY
AS (
	SELECT TAH.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE
		,TAH.BNK_CODE BANK_ID
		,TAH.CIF_ID CIF
		,SUM(COALESCE(TAH.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP, 0)) TRB_TREASURY
	FROM EDS.TREASURY_ACCOUNT_HOLDER TAH
	WHERE TAH.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('2025-11-28' AS DATE)
		AND TAH.FOR_EXCLUSION = 'N'
		AND TAH.IS_QUALIFIED = 'Y'
		AND TAH.PRODUCT_GROUP NOT IN (
			'FX Product'
			,'Derivative Product'
			)
	GROUP BY TAH.AS_OF_DATE
		,TAH.BNK_CODE
		,TAH.CIF_ID
	)
	,CUST_TOT_REL_TRU
AS (
	SELECT TAH.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE
		,TAH.BNK_CODE BANK_ID
		,TAH.CIF_ID CIF
		,SUM(COALESCE(TAH.MARKET_VALUE_PHP, 0)) TRB_TRUST
	FROM EDS.TRUST_ACCOUNT_HOLDER TAH
	WHERE TAH.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('2025-11-28' AS DATE)
		AND (
			TAH.PRODUCT_GROUP = 'UITF'
			OR TAH.PRODUCT_CODE = 'AIMA'
			)
		AND TAH.IS_QUALIFIED = 'Y'
	GROUP BY TAH.AS_OF_DATE
		,TAH.BNK_CODE
		,TAH.CIF_ID
	)
	,AGG_TRB
AS (
	SELECT DEP.AS_OF_DATE
		,DEP.BANK_ID
		,DEP.CIF
		,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_DEPOSITS, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_BANCA, 0)) TRB
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_DEPOSITS, 0)) TRB_DEPOSITS
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST, 0)) TRB_INVEST
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TRUST, 0)) TRB_TRUST
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY, 0)) TRB_TREASURY
		,TRB_BANCA
		,TRB_SECURITIES
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRE_LOANS, 0) + COALESCE(TRE_CARDS, 0)) TRE
		,TRE_LOANS
		,TRE_CARDS
	FROM CUST_TOT_REL_DEP DEP
	LEFT JOIN CUST_TOT_REL_TRY TRY ON DEP.CIF = TRY.CIF
		AND DEP.BANK_ID = TRY.BANK_ID
		AND DEP.AS_OF_DATE = TRY.AS_OF_DATE
	LEFT JOIN CUST_TOT_REL_TRU TRU ON DEP.CIF = TRU.CIF
		AND DEP.BANK_ID = TRU.BANK_ID
		AND DEP.AS_OF_DATE = TRU.AS_OF_DATE
	GROUP BY DEP.AS_OF_DATE
		,DEP.BANK_ID
		,DEP.CIF
		,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
		,TRB_BANCA
		,TRB_SECURITIES
		,TRE_LOANS
		,TRE_CARDS
	)
INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL (
	AS_OF_DATE
	,BANK_ID
	,CIF
	,CUST_SEGMENT_ID
	,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
	,TRB
	,TRB_DEPOSITS
	,TRB_INVEST
	,TRB_TRUST
	,TRB_TREASURY
	,TRB_BANCA
	,TRB_SECURITIES
	,TRE
	,TRE_LOANS
	,TRE_CARDS
	)
SELECT AGG_TRB.AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
	,AGG_TRB.BANK_ID
	,AGG_TRB.CIF
	,COALESCE(CSP.PARAM_ID, '006') AS CUST_SEGMENT_ID
	,AGG_TRB.TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
	,AGG_TRB.TRB
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_DEPOSITS
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_INVEST
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_TRUST
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_TREASURY
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_BANCA
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_SECURITIES
	,AGG_TRB.TRE
	,AGG_TRB.TRE_LOANS
	,AGG_TRB.TRE_CARDS
FROM AGG_TRB
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM CSP ON CSP.BANK_ID = AGG_TRB.BANK_ID
	AND COALESCE(TRB, 0) BETWEEN CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(CSP.FROM_VALUE, '0'), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38, 6))
		AND CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(CSP.TO_VALUE, '999,999,999,999,999'), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38, 6))
	AND AGG_TRB.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CSP.SCD_START_DATE
		AND CSP.SCD_END_DATE
